Car Renovated Two-Bedroom Villa with Archway EleganceWelcome to this absolutely refreshing two-bedroom, one-bathroom villa in the heart of Yokine. 2/201 Royal Street was built originally in 1980 but is beautifully presented today with brand new timber-look flooring throughout, fresh paintwork and stylish built in robes – as well as a chic wrap-around kitchen with gas cooking and built in rangehood. Archways in the transition spaces provide a warming Mediterranean influence. Tucked away in a strata complex of just 10 villas, this east facing property enjoys a total lot area of approximately 240 square metres and an internal floorspace of 77 square metres. There’s a single car carport right near your front door, and roller shutters to optimise privacy, security and sound protection. Built in robes in the bedrooms, and a full size laundry – provide you with plenty of storage options. Enjoy a cozy rear entertainment space, partially covered by a metal patio, and enough space for your green garden thumb to thrive. Vacant and immediately ready to be lived in and loved – or leased out with a market rent of $650 per week – this villa is not one to miss! Contact Adam Bettison 0409 929 128 to find out more.
